verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a first-party Cloudflare Workers edge integration that evaluates feature flags and Visual Editor experiments at the edge before HTML ships. It also offers the GrowthBook Proxy as a relay layer that caches SDK payloads close to the app. The cacheable JSON definition with local SDK evaluation supports this delivery model. Missing for 10: evidence of edge integrations beyond Cloudflare (other CDN worker platforms), and independent or hands-on corroboration of edge evaluation.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users

citations.quote: Evaluate GrowthBook feature flags and Visual Editor experiments at the edge on Cloudflare Workers to cut flicker before HTML ships.
Run the GrowthBook Proxy next to your app to cache SDK payloads, reduce latency, and keep serving flags if the API is down.
there's a single cacheable JSON definition of all of the features and then evaluation happens locally within the SDKs
